headline: Executive order signed April 23, 2025, directs federal action on preparing Americans for skilled trade jobs.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order aims to help prepare Americans for skilled trade jobs that pay well. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps it orders federal agencies to take are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People seeking training for skilled trade jobs
who_it_affects.how: The order's title suggests it focuses on preparing workers for skilled trade careers, but the specific effects are not stated in the available information.
